title: Patient Payment Plan Schedule of Terms: Enrollment Bands, Tier Entry and Plan Limits
content:
Each tier of the **Patient Payment Plan** opens on a band of enrolled balance. The minimum enrolled balance is the lowest total enrolled balance at plan creation for the tier; the maximum enrolled balance is the highest total enrolled balance for the tier. Two tiers are entered on other showings, stated in the entry column.

| Tier | Minimum enrolled balance (USD) | Maximum enrolled balance (USD) | Entry also requires |
|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | 50.00 | 499.99 | none beyond eligible balances |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | 500.00 | 1999.99 | none beyond eligible balances |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | 2000.00 | 4999.99 | down payment and autopay |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | 5000.00 | 24999.99 | down payment and autopay |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | 25.00 | 50000.00 | an approved financial assistance award with a partial discount (80%, 60% or 40% charity discount, or medical hardship) on the date the plan is created |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | 25.00 | 50000.00 | a documented loss of household income of at least 25 percent in the last 6 months, or enrolled balances above 25000.00 |

## Hardship showings

| Tier | Household income loss in the last 6 months that qualifies for the hardship plan (percent) | Total enrolled balance above which the hardship plan is available without an income-loss showing (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | 25 | 25000.00 |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | 25 | 25000.00 |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | 25 | 25000.00 |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | 25 | 25000.00 |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | 25 | 25000.00 |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | 25 | 25000.00 |

## Open plans, deadline to sign and agreement

| Tier | Plans a patient may hold in pending signature, active or past due status at once | Calendar days after the plan is offered (created) within which the patient must sign | Agreement the patient signs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | 1 | 14 | Riverbend Patient Payment Plan Agreement (PFS-210) |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | 1 | 14 | Riverbend Patient Payment Plan Agreement (PFS-210) |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | 1 | 14 | Riverbend Patient Payment Plan Agreement (PFS-210) |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | 1 | 14 | Riverbend Patient Payment Plan Agreement (PFS-210) |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | 1 | 21 | Riverbend Patient Payment Plan Agreement (PFS-210) |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | 1 | 21 | Riverbend Patient Payment Plan Agreement (PFS-210) |

### Reading the schedule

- A hypothetical enrolled total of 1200.00 sits inside the Standard band (500.00 to 1999.99); a hypothetical 499.99 is the top of the Short-Term band and 500.00 the bottom of the Standard band.
- The hardship figures are the same on every tier: a 25 percent household income loss over the last 6 months, or enrolled balances above 25000.00.
- Every tier allows 1 open plan at a time.
